_: THE SHOW TOOL'S CATALOG (agenttools `show`, viewspec.py; website/src/viewSpec.js reads the same file). The only element types an agent may draw in its chat, each prop's kind ('!' = required, 'a|b' = one of those words), and the caps. `every` is the props every type also takes. A button names a buttons.json verb that has a row id (it lights that button), an app link (#...) it opens, or an `on.press` action: answer (his pick goes to the agent once, as his press) or setState (a value of the view's own). Controls (slider, toggle, select, date) bind a value of the view's `state`; a value written {"$expr": "seats * 12"} or {"$state": "/seats"} is worked out on the page as they move (viewexpr). An availability is people and the time ranges each can make ({name, ranges: [{day, from, to}]} - no `ranges` is no reply yet); how many fit each slot and the best one are worked out on the page (availability.js), never given. Any view with an `id` shown again is drawn once, where it was just shown, as it now is - no older copy stays above it. Nothing here sends or pays.
